$comment: Total Gym exercise catalogue. See docs/adr/0004 for the copyright position.
Exercise NAMES are unprotectable short phrases (37 C.F.R. 202.1(a)) and the movements
themselves are unprotectable systems or methods (Bikram's Yoga College v. Evolation Yoga,
9th Cir. 2015). What IS protected is Total Gym's photography, illustration, and
instructional prose -- so every 'cue' line here is written from scratch and no artwork is
usesPulley  : true when the movement routes through the cable, which halves the load.
bodyFraction: share of bodyweight actually riding the glideboard. Supine work is ~1.0;
seated and kneeling positions put less of the trainee on the board.
THESE ARE ESTIMATES, not measurements -- see the open item in docs/adr/README.
Getting them wrong shifts absolute load but not progression, because every
set for an exercise uses the same figure.
muscles     : fraction 1.0 = prime mover, 0.5 = meaningful secondary involvement.
Fractional accounting matters because Total Gym work is almost all compound;

exercises.name: Chest Press
exercises.cue: Lie face up, handles level with your chest, press until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Chest Fly
exercises.cue: Lie face up, arms wide with a soft elbow, bring the handles together above you.

exercises.name: Pullover
exercises.cue: Lie face up, arms overhead, pull the handles down in an arc toward your hips.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.cue: Lie face up, reach overhead, pull down and back with your elbows leading.

exercises.name: Seated Row
exercises.cue: Sit upright facing the tower, pull the handles to your ribs, squeeze the shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press
exercises.cue: Sit facing away from the tower, press the handles overhead.

exercises.name: Upright Row
exercises.cue: Sit upright, draw the handles toward your collarbone with high elbows.

exercises.name: Biceps Curl
exercises.cue: Sit facing the tower, elbows tucked, curl the handles toward your shoulders.

exercises.name: Triceps Extension
exercises.cue: Sit facing away, elbows high and still, straighten your arms.

exercises.name: Squat
exercises.cue: Lie face up with both feet on the platform, push away until your legs are straight.

exercises.name: Single Leg Squat
exercises.cue: As the squat, one foot at a time. Keep the knee tracking over the toes.

exercises.name: Calf Raise
exercises.cue: Toes on the edge of the platform, push through the balls of your feet.

exercises.name: Leg Pull
exercises.cue: Hook your feet in the strap and draw your knees toward your chest.

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.cue: Lie face up, curl your ribs toward your hips without pulling on your neck.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction
exercises.cue: Lie on your side, drive the top leg away from the midline.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.cue: Lie face up under the bars, pull your chest toward your hands.
